instruction: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open. The PDF is already open in Chrome. Open the website link for the voter authority certificate application from the PDF in a new Chrome tab, leave that tab open, and leave the On-Screen Keyboard open.
gt_steps: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open.
Return to the PDF already open in Chrome.
Find the voter authority certificate application website link.
Open the link in a new Chrome tab.
Leave the linked website tab open.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$osk = Get-Process -Name osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 }; if ($osk) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_NOT_OPEN' }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$target='https://www.gov.uk/apply-for-photo-id-voter-authority-certificate'; try { $tabs=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:1337/json'; $found=$false; foreach($tab in $tabs) { if ($tab.url -eq $target -or $tab.url.StartsWith($target + '?') -or $tab.url.StartsWith($target + '#')) { $found=$true; break } }; if($found) { Write-Output 'TARGET_TAB_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'TARGET_TAB_NOT_OPEN' } } catch { Write-Output 'TARGET_TAB_NOT_OPEN' }"
